settings.title: Cloud sync
settings.intro: Every sale is saved on this counter first. When the internet is up, sync sends it to the cloud and brings in what the other counters did.
settings.chainBroken: The audit trail of counter {{code}} has a gap (from entry {{seq}}). Check that counter's Audit screen.
settings.registerIntro: Sign in with the store owner's cloud account. The password is used once and never stored on this counter.
settings.deadIntro: The cloud refused these changes. Retry sends the row again as it is now; Discard keeps it on this counter only. Both are recorded in the audit log.

join.choose: How is this counter being set up?
join.newStoreHint: The first counter of a store.
join.joinStoreHint: Another counter for a store that is already in the cloud.
join.title: Join an existing store
join.intro: Sign in with the store owner's cloud account. This counter gets the next counter code and the store's full history.
join.resumeIntro: This counter joined the store but hasn't received all of its history yet.
